title: 分区器：murmur2 映射与分布均匀度检验
expected_output:
=== Kafka 默认分区器 ===
partition_of(key) = to_positive(murmur2(key)) % numPartitions
to_positive(x) = x & 0x7fffffff  (Java 的 int 溢出友好写法)

numPartitions = 6
  key=user-A    murmur2=5a62a07e  -> partition 0
  key=user-B    murmur2=34e5e5e7  -> partition 3
  key=user-C    murmur2=ed942c43  -> partition 5
  key=user-D    murmur2=bce7f1f7  -> partition 5
  key=user-E    murmur2=1c344cdd  -> partition 5
  key=user-F    murmur2=d6894eb6  -> partition 0
  key=order-1   murmur2=48d1d1f6  -> partition 4
  key=order-2   murmur2=c1165d03  -> partition 3
  key=pay-X     murmur2=a5a0e215  -> partition 3
  key=sku-9     murmur2=fd01ffd9  -> partition 1
各分区消息数 = [2, 1, 0, 3, 1, 3]

=== 分布均匀度对照（1000 个 key, 6 个分区）===
  murmur2 (Kafka 默认)     负载 = [153, 157, 156, 160, 184, 190]
                         最大偏差率 =  14.00%   卡方 =     7.70
  弱哈希 (首字符+长度)           负载 = [0, 0, 0, 10, 90, 900]
                         最大偏差率 = 440.00%   卡方 =  3909.20

=== 判定（卡方检验，自由度 5，显著性 0.05，临界值 11.07）===
  murmur2 (Kafka 默认)     卡方=    7.70 -> 无法拒绝均匀
  弱哈希 (首字符+长度)           卡方= 3909.20 -> 拒绝均匀（分布偏斜）

=== 结论（由实测卡方值推导）===
  murmur2 卡方 7.70 < 11.07, 弱哈希卡方 3909.20 >= 11.07
  -> 单看「最大偏差率」容易被抽样波动误导（n=1000 时偏差率本身就有 7.7% 量级的随机波动）
  -> 卡方检验是分布均匀性的标准判据：murmur2 通过，弱哈希被拒绝

=== 三个必须记住的设计约束 ===
1) 同一 key 永远映射到同一分区 -> 该 key 的消息天然有序
2) key 为 null 时走 sticky/轮询, 不保证顺序
3) 分区数只能增不能减; 扩容会改变 key->分区 映射, 破坏跨期顺序
code:
def murmur2(data: bytes) -> int:
    """Kafka Utils.murmur2 的等价实现（32 位无符号）。"""
    length = len(data)
    seed = 0x9747b28c
    m = 0x5bd1e995
    r = 24
    h = (seed ^ length) & 0xffffffff
    i = 0
    while length - i >= 4:
        k = data[i] | (data[i + 1] << 8) | (data[i + 2] << 16) | (data[i + 3] << 24)
        k = (k * m) & 0xffffffff
        k ^= k >> r
        k = (k * m) & 0xffffffff
        h = (h * m) & 0xffffffff
        h ^= k
        i += 4
    rem = length - i
    if rem == 3:
        h ^= data[i + 2] << 16
    if rem >= 2:
        h ^= data[i + 1] << 8
    if rem >= 1:
        h ^= data[i]
        h = (h * m) & 0xffffffff
    h ^= h >> 13
    h = (h * m) & 0xffffffff
    h ^= h >> 15
    return h


def to_positive(x: int) -> int:
    return x & 0x7fffffff


def partition_of(key: str, n: int) -> int:
    return to_positive(murmur2(key.encode("utf-8"))) % n

print("=== Kafka 默认分区器 ===")
print("partition_of(key) = to_positive(murmur2(key)) % numPartitions")
print("to_positive(x) = x & 0x7fffffff  (Java 的 int 溢出友好写法)")
print()
NPART = 6
keys = ["user-A", "user-B", "user-C", "user-D", "user-E", "user-F",
        "order-1", "order-2", "pay-X", "sku-9"]
counts = [0] * NPART
print("numPartitions =", NPART)
for k in keys:
    p = partition_of(k, NPART)
    counts[p] += 1
    print("  key=%-8s  murmur2=%08x  -> partition %d" % (k, murmur2(k.encode("utf-8")), p))
print("各分区消息数 =", counts)
print()


def weak_hash(key, n):
    """反面教材: 只取首字符 ASCII 加长度, 完全没有雪崩效应"""
    return (ord(key[0]) + len(key)) % n


def chi_square(buckets):
    e = sum(buckets) / len(buckets)
    return sum((c - e) ** 2 / e for c in buckets)


def deviation_pct(buckets):
    e = sum(buckets) / len(buckets)
    return max(abs(c - e) for c in buckets) / e * 100


N = 1000
print("=== 分布均匀度对照（%d 个 key, %d 个分区）===" % (N, NPART))
table = {}
for label, fn in (("murmur2 (Kafka 默认)", partition_of),
                  ("弱哈希 (首字符+长度)", weak_hash)):
    b = [0] * NPART
    for i in range(N):
        b[fn("user-%d" % i, NPART)] += 1
    chi2 = chi_square(b)
    dev = deviation_pct(b)
    table[label] = (b, chi2, dev)
    print("  %-22s 负载 = %s" % (label, b))
    print("  %-22s 最大偏差率 = %6.2f%%   卡方 = %8.2f" % ("", dev, chi2))

CHI_CRIT = 11.07          # 自由度 5, 显著性 0.05
print()
print("=== 判定（卡方检验，自由度 %d，显著性 0.05，临界值 %.2f）===" % (NPART - 1, CHI_CRIT))
for label, (b, chi2, dev) in table.items():
    verdict = "无法拒绝均匀" if chi2 < CHI_CRIT else "拒绝均匀（分布偏斜）"
    print("  %-22s 卡方=%8.2f -> %s" % (label, chi2, verdict))

mchi = table["murmur2 (Kafka 默认)"][1]
wchi = table["弱哈希 (首字符+长度)"][1]
print()
print("=== 结论（由实测卡方值推导）===")
print("  murmur2 卡方 %.2f %s %.2f, 弱哈希卡方 %.2f %s %.2f"
      % (mchi, "<" if mchi < CHI_CRIT else ">=", CHI_CRIT,
         wchi, "<" if wchi < CHI_CRIT else ">=", CHI_CRIT))
print("  -> 单看「最大偏差率」容易被抽样波动误导（n=%d 时偏差率本身就有 %.1f%% 量级的随机波动）"
      % (N, 100.0 / (N / NPART) ** 0.5))
print("  -> 卡方检验是分布均匀性的标准判据：murmur2 通过，弱哈希被拒绝")
print()
print("=== 三个必须记住的设计约束 ===")
print("1) 同一 key 永远映射到同一分区 -> 该 key 的消息天然有序")
print("2) key 为 null 时走 sticky/轮询, 不保证顺序")
print("3) 分区数只能增不能减; 扩容会改变 key->分区 映射, 破坏跨期顺序")
